title: design-system.json
description: What every screen of a project is drawn in: the tokens, the font files and the images, and the base stylesheet every screen is given. It is the artifact of the design_system stage.

tokens.description: Every value a screen is drawn in, by the name the page writes into a custom property. The colour and the font groups are required, because a screen is drawn in nothing without them.

assets.description: The font files and the images the screens are drawn with. A screen and the stylesheet reach one with url(asset:<name>), so the name is the address.

css.description: The base stylesheet every screen is given. It paints from the tokens, it reaches an asset with url(asset:<name>), and it holds no other address and no @import.

group.description: One group of tokens, a name to a css value.

asset.description: One file, carried inside the design system so it travels with it.

media.description: What the file is, as the media type the page writes into the address.

data.description: The bytes of the file, base64, with no data address prefix.

family.description: The font family name, required when the kind is font. A font token has to name it, or no screen can reach the file.

weight.description: A css font weight. It reads 400 when it is not written.

style.description: A css font style. It reads normal when it is not written.

label.description: What the file is, for a person reading the design system page.
